task.title: Canonical migration reconciliation with the real staging schema (forward-only)
task.business_value: Makes canonical main safely compatible with the staging schema without rewriting applied migrations or risking the 10 feedback rows, 1 remediation snapshot and 325 remediation actions on staging.
task.objective: Audit the supplied migration matrix, preserve all 109 existing migrations byte-for-byte, add one forward-only idempotent reconciliation migration generated from main's own migrations, prove it on bare, main-shaped and staging-shaped disposable databases (rows preserved, idempotent, nothing removed), record ledger uncertainty, open a draft PR, no merge, no deployment, no live database access.

out: modifying, renaming or deleting any applied migration
importing staging-only migration names into main

steps.action: Input gate: ZIP identity, 32/32 sums, manifest, drift list, 13+8 migrations, conflict pair, 3 identical pairs, schema evidence, secret scan
Independent audit of the matrix: byte-identical pairs confirmed by hash; 14-vs-7 table discrepancy found and recorded
Generate the forward-only idempotent migration from main's own files; no DROP TABLE/TRUNCATE/DELETE/DROP COLUMN
Dry-run on disposable PostgreSQL 16: bare, main-shaped, staging-shaped (seeded 10/1/325); idempotency and row preservation asserted
Gates, commit, push, draft PR against main (not merge-ready while the ledger is unverified)
Attach the staging applied-migration ledger and the seven-table check

gates: migration dry-run (bare, main-shaped, staging-shaped) with data-preservation assertions
task.rollback: Close the PR or delete the single new migration file; nothing has been applied to any database.
